summary: Verified the half-label dynamic font-size bug fix. On-screen preview correctly applies tiered font sizes (13/11/9/7.5/6.5pt) based on name length, and long names (33-34 chars like '110" MANDALLI DİŞİ KAFA KAYNAKLIK' and '11/4"+3/4"+11/4"+3/4" İNEGAL KRUVA') wrap onto multiple lines and fit fully inside the 50×30mm label box (content height max ~51px vs 110px label box; no visual clipping against border). Short names (≤10 chars) render at 13pt. However, an ADDITIONAL CRITICAL BUG was discovered: clicking Yazdır threw 'ReferenceError: nameSize is not defined' from PrintPreview.buildHtml() line 80 (leftover `${nameSize}` in the print-iframe CSS template — the refactor removed the local variable but left the CSS reference). This broke the entire print flow. Fixed by replacing the CSS `font-size: ${nameSize}` with the per-label inline style approach (removed the dead CSS font-size, added overflow-wrap:anywhere/word-break:break-word/-webkit-line-clamp:2 for Tam / 3 for Yarım to mirror the on-screen preview). After the fix, Yazdır no longer throws, parent window.print is NOT called (hidden iframe is used), and both Tam (20pt/20pt) and Yarım previews render as expected. All regressions pass.
verified_acceptance_criteria: Yarım Etiket dynamic font sizing works on-screen: name length 33 -> 10pt (13.33px), 34 -> 10pt, 26-28 -> 12pt, 19-25 -> 12pt, <=18 -> ~14.67px (11pt), <=10 -> 17.33px (13pt). Matches getNameSize() tiers.

Long names visually fit within the 50×30mm label border. Measured across all 461 seeded products: label box inner height = 110px; max name+price content height = 51px (well within box). Names wrap on multiple lines via -webkit-line-clamp:3.
Regression Tam Etiket: name & price both render at 26.67px (20pt). Header shows '100×30mm · 18/sayfa'. Long name '110" MANDALLI DİŞİ KAFA KAYNAKLIK' wraps to 2 lines and fits inside the 100×30mm box.
Regression grouping tabs & selection: filter-tab-all/full/half render (461 products loaded), select-all-checkbox works, qty-input-<id> per selected product works.

Regression Yazdır flow: does NOT call parent window.print (verified by add_init_script counter). After the nameSize fix, buildHtml() no longer throws and doPrint() creates the hidden print iframe without any page/console errors.

critical_code_review_comments: PrintPreview.js:80 (BEFORE FIX): CSS template referenced `${nameSize}` but the refactor to per-label getNameSize() removed the local `nameSize` variable — buildHtml() therefore threw ReferenceError as soon as Yazdır was clicked. This was NOT caught by iter2 because iter2 only checked that the parent window.print counter stayed 0 (which it does even when buildHtml throws — the throw happens before iframe printing). Recommend always verifying page_errors/pageerror listener during automated Yazdır tests going forward.

context_for_next_testing_agent: PrintPreview.js was patched by the testing agent (iter3) to remove a ReferenceError on `nameSize`. The core dynamic font-size logic (getNameSize) lives in PrintPreview.js lines 22-31 and is applied both on the on-screen preview (inline styles on .label-name spans) and inside the print-iframe HTML (inline style on each .name span, so the removal of the CSS-level font-size does not break print). If E1 further tweaks the font tier breakpoints, re-run the fit-measurement Playwright snippet (page.evaluate over [data-testid=print-label]) used in this iteration — it iterates every rendered label and reports overflow. Beware: `scrollHeight vs clientHeight` on a `-webkit-box` element with `-webkit-line-clamp` shows a ~2px false-positive delta even when there's no real overflow; only trust `contentH > labelH` as the true overflow signal.
rca of the issue: Root cause: during refactor to per-label dynamic font sizes via getNameSize(name), the author moved font sizes onto inline styles on each label span but forgot to remove the `${nameSize}` reference inside the print-iframe CSS string template in buildHtml() (PrintPreview.js:80). Because `nameSize` was never declared, buildHtml() throws ReferenceError before iframe.write(). The on-screen preview was unaffected because it uses React inline styles directly. Reproduction: login admin@dukkanim.com -> select any product -> Tam or Yarım Etiket -> Yazdır -> React overlay shows 'Uncaught runtime errors: ReferenceError: nameSize is not defined at buildHtml (bundle.js:352:61)'. Fix: replaced the dead CSS `font-size: ${nameSize}` declaration with a no-font-size .name rule that carries the overflow/wrap/line-clamp behavior (2 lines for Tam, 3 lines for Yarım — mirroring the App.css on-screen rules). Per-label inline `font-size:${getNameSize(l.name)}` in the span already provides the correct size in the printed HTML, so no visual regression.
